dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、今日の夕飯、なに食べたい？」
dialogues.en: "What do you want to eat for dinner tonight, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want to eat for dinner tonight, niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢がいるのに自室に引きこもるのも何なので、
居間でテレビを見ていたら、声をかけられた。
dialogues.en: Nemu asked me as I watched TV in the living room.
dialogues.text: Nemu asked me as I watched TV in the living room.

dialogues.jp: 「別にコンビニ弁当でいいんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "We can get something from the convenience store."
dialogues.text: "We can get something from the convenience store."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ダ・メ・で・す。そんなんじゃ栄養のバラン
　スが取れないじゃない。任せて。休みの間は
　私が作ってあげる」
dialogues.en:
"No. It's not nutritious enough. I'll cook for you while I'm
at home."
dialogues.text:
"No. It's not nutritious enough. I'll cook for you while I'm
at home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て。何でお前が飯を作るんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute. Why are you going to cook?"
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute. Why are you going to cook?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、できる時に作っておかないと、もう
　そんなに機会もなさそうだし」
dialogues.en:
"I have to cook for you when I can. I don't have the
opportunity to do it that much."
dialogues.text:
"I have to cook for you when I can. I don't have the
opportunity to do it that much."

dialogues.jp: しおらしく言うが、そんなことでは騙されない。
dialogues.en: She spoke innocently, but I'm not being fooled.
dialogues.text: She spoke innocently, but I'm not being fooled.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、そんな気は遣わんでいいって。それに
　まだ俺、昼飯も食べてないし」
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to worry about it. Besides, I haven't even
had my lunch yet."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to worry about it. Besides, I haven't even
had my lunch yet."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今日は朝昼兼食です」
dialogues.en: "Your breakfast was your lunch today."
dialogues.text: "Your breakfast was your lunch today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ。帰省祝いに、今日は外食にしようか。
　どこがいい？」
dialogues.en:
"I know! We'll go out for dinner as a part of your welcome
home celebration. Where do you want to go?"
dialogues.text:
"I know! We'll go out for dinner as a part of your welcome
home celebration. Where do you want to go?"

dialogues.jp:
ポンと手を打って、華麗で優雅で｛さわ／爽｝やかな笑み
を作りあげる。
dialogues.en: I clapped my hands and gave a fresh smile.
dialogues.text: I clapped my hands and gave a fresh smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お家」
dialogues.en: "I want to stay home."
dialogues.text: "I want to stay home."

dialogues.jp: こちらも俺とタメを張る可愛らしい笑顔。
dialogues.en: She also smiled with a cute face.
dialogues.text: She also smiled with a cute face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……せめて１番得意なもので頼む……」
dialogues.en:
"......Hah...... will you make something you know you won't
mess up......?"
dialogues.text:
"......Hah...... will you make something you know you won't
mess up......?"

dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: Ding dong.
dialogues.text: Ding dong.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が料理の本を見ながら、今日作る毒物を調
べている――それを怖々と見ているとインター
ホンが鳴った。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was looking at the recipe book, studying whatever kind
of poisonous food she's cooking tonight. As I was staring at
her with fear, I heard the door bell ring.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was looking at the recipe book, studying whatever kind
of poisonous food she's cooking tonight. As I was staring at
her with fear, I heard the door bell ring.

dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 『あたしだけど』
dialogues.en: "It's me."
dialogues.text: "It's me."

dialogues.jp: 意外な珍客に思わず聞き返す。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 『うん。ちょっと開けてくれる？』
dialogues.en: I asked with surprise. This is unexpected.
dialogues.text: I asked with surprise. This is unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Will you open the door?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Will you open the door?"

dialogues.jp: 玄関に向かいながら、少し鬱な気分になる。
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
眞子からはどうしても萌先輩のことが連想され
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
I headed toward the front door and felt a little depressed.
I thought about Moe-sempai when I heard Mako's voice.
dialogues.text:
I headed toward the front door and felt a little depressed.
I thought about Moe-sempai when I heard Mako's voice.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.jp: 家のドアを開けて、眞子を玄関に招き入れる。
dialogues.en: I opened the door and invited Mako into the house.
dialogues.text: I opened the door and invited Mako into the house.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うん……ちょっと朝倉に｛き／訊｝きたいことがあっ
　てさ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... I wanted to ask you about something."
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... I wanted to ask you about something."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「訊きたいこと？」
dialogues.en: "You want to ask me something?"
dialogues.text: "You want to ask me something?"

dialogues.jp:
わざわざ連休中に家まで来るとは、いったい何
を訊きたいのだろう？
dialogues.en:
I wonder what she wants. She came all the way to my house on
a holiday.
dialogues.text:
I wonder what she wants. She came all the way to my house on
a holiday.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん、お姉ちゃんのことなんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it's about my sister."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it's about my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Moe...... sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Moe...... sempai?"

dialogues.jp:
“さよなら”と言われたときの顔が、目の前に
ちらつく。
dialogues.en:
I can't stop thinking about the look on her face when she
told me goodbye.
dialogues.text:
I can't stop thinking about the look on her face when she
told me goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや……で、萌先輩がどうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Nothing...... So what's wrong with Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Nothing...... So what's wrong with Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.jp: 表情を隠して、話をふる。
dialogues.en: I asked her as I hid my emotion.
dialogues.text: I asked her as I hid my emotion.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと最近、様子が変なんだよね」
dialogues.en: "Well...... She's been acting strange lately."
dialogues.text: "Well...... She's been acting strange lately."

dialogues.jp:
確かに、変だったな。まさか、それがフラれる
ことに繋がろうとは思ってもなかったけど……。
dialogues.en:
Indeed she was. I never thought she would reject me because
of it......
dialogues.text:
Indeed she was. I never thought she would reject me because
of it......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それで、なんか心当たりがないかと思って」
dialogues.en: "I was wondering if you knew what was wrong with her."
dialogues.text: "I was wondering if you knew what was wrong with her."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、ないけど」
dialogues.en: "......I don't know."
dialogues.text: "......I don't know."

dialogues.jp:
さすがに先輩の妹といえど言えることではない。
フラれたなんて、言えるわけがない……。
dialogues.en:
Although she's Moe-sempai's sister, I can't reveal that I
was rejected by her.
dialogues.text:
Although she's Moe-sempai's sister, I can't reveal that I
was rejected by her.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「何でもいいんだけど。普段と変わったことと
　かなかった？」
dialogues.en:
"Tell me anything. Has she been doing anything strange, or
different to normal?"
dialogues.text:
"Tell me anything. Has she been doing anything strange, or
different to normal?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「変わったことね……あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Anything different, huh......?"
dialogues.text: "Anything different, huh......?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「そう言えばお昼に、前に飲んでた錠剤をまた
　飲み始めてたかな……」
dialogues.en:
"She was taking the pills she used to take during lunch
time......"
dialogues.text:
"She was taking the pills she used to take during lunch
time......"

dialogues.jp:
フラれたことを隠したくて、当り障りのないこ
とを適当に答える。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to hide the fact that I was rejected, and told her
an irrelevant thing.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to hide the fact that I was rejected, and told her
an irrelevant thing.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「えっ！？　錠剤って、前に飲んでたヤツ？」
dialogues.en: "What? You mean the pills she was taking before?"
dialogues.text: "What? You mean the pills she was taking before?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Huh? Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
眞子の迫力に思わず身をひいてしまう。こんな、
どうでも良さそうなことに反応するとは、思わ
なかった。
dialogues.en:
Mako's reaction made me surprised. I didn't think she would
react this way to irrelevant information I offered.
dialogues.text:
Mako's reaction made me surprised. I didn't think she would
react this way to irrelevant information I offered.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん……それが……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What is it, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "What is it, niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 料理の本を片手に、音夢が居間から出てくる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu came out from the living room with the recipe book in
her hand.
dialogues.text:
Nemu came out from the living room with the recipe book in
her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「音夢！？　どうしてここにいるの？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu? Why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu? Why are you here?"

dialogues.jp:
何か大事なことを言おうとしていた眞子だが、
音夢の姿を見て、驚きの声をあげる。
dialogues.en:
Mako was trying to say something important, but seeing Nemu
clearly surprised her.
dialogues.text:
Mako was trying to say something important, but seeing Nemu
clearly surprised her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっとゴールデンウィーク中だけ、帰省す
　ることにしたんです」
dialogues.en: "I came back home for the Golden Week vacation."
dialogues.text: "I came back home for the Golden Week vacation."

dialogues.jp: どうやら裏モードは今も健在なようだ。
dialogues.en: She answered elegantly with a smile.
dialogues.text: She answered elegantly with a smile.

dialogues.jp: （……さすがだ）
dialogues.en: (......That's Nemu.)
dialogues.text: (......That's Nemu.)

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「？　その手に持ってるのってなに？」
dialogues.en: "What do you have in your hand?"
dialogues.text: "What do you have in your hand?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これですか？　お料理の本です。こっちにい
　る間は、兄さんに料理を作ってあげようと思
　いまして」
dialogues.en:
"Oh this? It's a recipe book. I'm going to cook for niisan
while I'm here."
dialogues.text:
"Oh this? It's a recipe book. I'm going to cook for niisan
while I'm here."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ、そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.jp: ここにいる間？
dialogues.en: She's going to cook while she's here?
dialogues.text: She's going to cook while she's here?

dialogues.jp: （――俺は長生きできないらしい）

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ朝倉、あたしは帰るよ」
dialogues.en: "Well Asakura, I'm going home."
dialogues.text: "Well Asakura, I'm going home."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「おい、さっき何か言おうとしてなかったか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, weren't you just trying to say something?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, weren't you just trying to say something?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うん？　まあ、また今度ね。せっかくの家族
　団らんをじゃましちゃ悪いし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'll tell you next time. I don't want to interrupt
your quality time with your sister."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'll tell you next time. I don't want to interrupt
your quality time with your sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんね、眞子」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry Mako."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。じゃあね」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. See you later."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. See you later."

dialogues.jp: 音夢に微笑みかけて眞子が出て行く。
dialogues.en: Mako smiled at Nemu and left.
dialogues.text: Mako smiled at Nemu and left.

dialogues.jp: 「結局あいつ……何をしに来たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What did she come here for......?"
dialogues.text: "What did she come here for......?"

dialogues.jp:
呟きながら、やはりなにかあったらしい萌先輩
のことだけに気になった。
dialogues.en: As I murmured, my mind was consumed with Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: As I murmured, my mind was consumed with Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: （フラれたのにな……）
dialogues.en: (I'm the one who got rejected......)
dialogues.text: (I'm the one who got rejected......)

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねえねえ兄さん、これなんかどうかな♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey niisan, what do you think of this one?"
dialogues.text: "Hey niisan, what do you think of this one?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、はしゃいで料理本を見せてくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu showed me the recipe book with excitement.
dialogues.text: Nemu showed me the recipe book with excitement.

dialogues.jp:
だから、１番得意なのを作ってくれって言った
のに、どうして本を見せてくるんだッ！
dialogues.en:
I told her to cook something she won't mess up. Why's she
showing me the recipe book?
dialogues.text:
I told her to cook something she won't mess up. Why's she
showing me the recipe book?

dialogues.jp: はぁ――。
dialogues.en: Sigh......
dialogues.text: Sigh......

dialogues.jp: 「……いいんじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "......It looks fine."
dialogues.text: "......It looks fine."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか毒でも食べてないと、やってられそう
になかった。
dialogues.en: I might as well just eat her poison.
dialogues.text: I might as well just eat her poison.

dialogues.jp: ◆眞子が来た◆
dialogues.en: ◆Mako came over◆
dialogues.text: ◆Mako came over◆

dialogues.jp:
眞子がやって来た。萌先輩の様子が変な理由を、
俺に尋ねてきたのだ。
dialogues.en:
Mako came to my house and asked me why Moe-sempai was acting
strange lately.
dialogues.text:
Mako came to my house and asked me why Moe-sempai was acting
strange lately.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに開けっぴろげに言う訳にはいかず、適
当な言葉でお茶を濁そうとした。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't tell her everything, so I gave her irrelevant
information.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't tell her everything, so I gave her irrelevant
information.

dialogues.jp:
が──たまたま口にした錠剤の事に、眞子は、
一瞬だけ真剣な表情を浮かべたのだった。
dialogues.en:
However...... Mako had a serious expression when I told her
about the pills Moe-sempai was taking.
dialogues.text:
However...... Mako had a serious expression when I told her
about the pills Moe-sempai was taking.
